candidates: When writing cross-links in documentation source files under `packages/mermaid/src/docs/`, always use relative paths with `.md` extensions (e.g., `../config/advanced.md` or `./getting-started.md#anchor`) rather than absolute `https://mermaid-js.github.io/mermaid/#/...` URLs. Absolute legacy URLs cause unnecessary redirects and will break silently if the target page is later renamed.

In `docker-compose.yml`, ensure the service's `mem_limit` is at least as large as the Node.js heap size specified by `NODE_OPTIONS=--max_old_space_size=<MB>` (convert units: 1 GiB ≈ 1024 MiB). Docker enforces `mem_limit` as a hard cap, so a heap limit larger than the container's memory limit is silently ignored and the process will be killed before reaching it.

When renaming or moving a documentation page, update both maps in `packages/mermaid/src/docs/.vitepress/theme/redirect.ts`: add the old `mermaid-js.github.io/#/<slug>` key to `idRedirectMap`, and add the old VitePress HTML path (e.g., `/intro/old-name.html`) as a key in `urlRedirectMap`. Omitting the `urlRedirectMap` entry leaves users who navigate directly to the old HTML URL without a redirect.
